type Tag = `#${number}`;
const make: () => Tag = () => `#${1}`;
console.log(make());

const shout: () => Uppercase<string> = () => "OK";
console.log(shout());

const title: (name: string) => Capitalize<string> | number = (name) => (name ? "Hi" : 0);
console.log(title("x"), title(""));

interface Shape {
  kind: "circle" | "square";
}
const pick: () => Shape["kind"] = () => "circle";
console.log(pick());

const keyOf: () => keyof Shape = () => "kind";
console.log(keyOf());

function choose(flag: boolean) {
  if (flag) return "yes";
  return "no";
}
const answer: "yes" | "no" = choose(true);
console.log(answer);

const sign = (n: number) => (n < 0 ? -1 : 1);
const unit: -1 | 1 = sign(-5);
console.log(unit);

function maybe(flag: boolean) {
  if (flag) return "found";
}
const found: "found" | undefined = maybe(false);
console.log(found);
